title: Get Affiliate Partner Campaign Detail
label: TIKTOK SHOP · API REFERENCE
subtitle: Updated 2026-10-15
html:
Path: /affiliate_partner/202405/campaigns/{campaign_id}

Method: [GET]

Function Description

This API offers the ability to get affiliate campaign details.

Common Parameters

For common parameters, refer to How to call TikTok Shop APIs - Common Parameters

Properties Location Type Require Sample Properties description
content-type header string Y application/json Allowed type: application/json
category_asset_cipher query string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 The partner identifier used in API requests. Retrieve this value by using the Get Authorized Category Assets API.

Request Path Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
campaign_id string Y 7373988288167036678 The campaign ID in decimal integer format.

Request Query Parameters

Properties Type Require Sample Properties description
app_key string Y 38abcd Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.
sign string Y 5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.
timestamp int Y 1623812664 Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.
category_asset_cipher string Y GCP_XF90igAAAABh00qsWgtvOiGFNqyubMt3 The partner identifier used in API requests. Retrieve this value by using the Get Authorized Category Assets API.

Request Sample

Query

https://open-api.tiktokglobalshop.com/affiliate_partner/202405/campaigns/7373988288167036678?app_key=123abc&sign=5361235029d141222525e303d742f9e38aea052d10896d3197ab9d6233730b8c&timestamp=1625484268&category_asset_cipher=ROW_RHkDDABBAAB8tKAVoAqsMTjsQZFLyNfY

Response Parameters

Properties Type Sample Properties description
code int 0 The success or failure status code returned in API response.
message string Success The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.
request_id string 202203070749000101890810281E8C70B7 Request log
data object Specific return information
^id string 7356876895365105455 The campaign identifier.
^name string test_campaign The campaign name. Maximum length: 50 characters.
^description string Campaign for api test. The campaign description. Maximum length: 1000 characters.
^status string READY The campaign status. The status is an enumerated type with values:
  • READY
  • UPCOMING
  • ONGOING
  • CLOSED | ^region |string |US |The region to which the campaign is associated. | ^registration_start_time |int |1712941200 |The scheduled start time for seller product registration as a Unix timestamp in seconds. This field can be updated only when the campaign status is READY or UPCOMING. | ^registration_end_time |int |1713891599 |The scheduled end time for seller product registration as a Unix timestamp in seconds. This field is no longer editable when the campaign status is CLOSED. | ^campaign_start_time |int |1712941200 |The scheduled campaign start time as a Unix timestamp in seconds. This field can be updated only when the campaign status is READY or UPCOMING. | ^campaign_end_time |int |1715878799 |The scheduled end time in Unix epoch time format for the campaign. Note that the end time must be less than 360 days from the start date. This field is no longer editable when the campaign status is set to CLOSED. | ^commission_rate |int |1000 |The total commission rate in hundredths of a percent (0.01%) units proposed by the affiliate partner for display to sellers. Commission rate must be greater than 100 and less than 8000. | ^contact_info |object | |The campaign creator's contact information. | ^^whatsapp |string |+14255550100 |WhatsApp account number | ^^email |string |123456@gmail.com |Email | ^^phone |string |+14255550100 |Phone number | ^^zalo |string |+14255550100 |Zalo account number | ^^viber |string |+14255550100 |Viber account number | ^^line |string |+14255550100 |Line account number | ^target_shops |[]object | |A list of TikTok Shop seller shop codes and names with permission to register for the campaign. | ^^code |string |THCBELNL4Y |The seller shop code in available in TikTok Shop Seller Central by clicking on the Seller Profile icon in the top right of the user interface. | ^^name |string |my_shop |The TikTok Shop name. | ^target_seller_types |[]string |["LOCAL"] |A list of seller types eligible to register for the campaign. Use this field to broadly target seller types instead of the specific shops listed in target_shops. Possible values:
  • LOCAL
  • CROSS_BORDER |
